basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Filewall%20for%20Microsoft%20365/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. Filewall for Microsoft 365 solution installs a Codeless (CCF/CLv2) connector that ingests Filewall activity logs for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams into custom tables. It also installs parsers, a workbook, analytics rules that alert on malicious and suspicious files by verdict, and rules and hunting queries that correlate Filewall file hashes with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint device file events. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 3, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 3, **Hunting Queries:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Filewall for Microsoft 365. You can get Filewall for Microsoft 365 data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

link.label: Learn more about connecting data sources

options.text: This solution installs workbooks to visualize Filewall activity.
Provides an overview of Filewall for Microsoft 365 activity across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams, including blocked emails and files.
This solution installs analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: Filewall - Malicious or suspicious email attachment blocked

options.text:
Identifies attachments in inbound email that Filewall for Microsoft 365 blocked because an antivirus engine found malware (High severity), or because static analysis flagged the file or its content does not match its file type (Medium severity).
Attachments blocked only by a policy rule (file type, size or encryption) and attachments sanitized by CDR are not malware verdicts and do not raise this alert; they stay available in the FilewallM365EmailAttachmentEvent parser.
The alert maps the recipient, the message and the original file hashes, so Microsoft Defender XDR can correlate it with other evidence for the same file or user, and it links to the message in the Filewall console.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: Filewall - Malicious or suspicious file blocked in SharePoint, OneDrive or Teams

options.text:
Identifies SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams files that Filewall for Microsoft 365 blocked because an antivirus engine found malware (High severity), or because static analysis flagged the file or its content does not match its file type (Medium severity).
Files blocked only by a policy rule (file type, size or encryption) and files sanitized by CDR are not malware verdicts and do not raise this alert; they stay available in the FilewallM365FileEvent parser.
The alert maps the file owner, the file and its original hashes, so Microsoft Defender XDR can correlate it with other evidence for the same file or user, and it links to the file in the Filewall console.

elements.name: analytic3
elements.label: Filewall - File Filewall blocked as malicious or suspicious seen on a device

options.text:
Correlates files that Filewall for Microsoft 365 blocked as malicious or suspicious, in email attachments or in SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams, with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint file events.
A match means the original file reached a device by another path after Filewall blocked it, for example a direct download, a removable drive, another mail flow or a copy released from quarantine.
The match is on the original file hash Filewall recorded; the sanitized hash is kept in the custom details. Requires the Microsoft Defender XDR connector to stream DeviceFileEvents into the workspace.
This solution installs the following hunting queries. After installing the solution, run these hunting queries to hunt for threats in Manage solution view.

elements.name: huntingquery1
elements.label: Filewall - Original of a file Filewall sanitized seen on a device

options.text:
Finds devices holding the original, unsanitized copy of a file that Filewall for Microsoft 365 sanitized, in inbound email or in SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
Filewall removed active content from these files before delivering them, so a device with the original hash got the file another way: a direct download, a removable drive, another mail flow or a copy released from Filewall.
Sanitizing is a policy action, not a malware verdict, so this is a hunting query rather than an alert. The sanitized hash is shown next to the original, and the report link opens the item in the Filewall console. Requires the Microsoft Defender XDR connector to stream DeviceFileEvents into the workspace. This hunting query depends on FilewallM365 MicrosoftThreatProtection data connector (FilewallExchange_CL FilewallFile_CL DeviceFileEvents Parser or Table)
